apps.askBody: On the PC that runs alpacawork, open an AI agent such as Claude Code or Codex in a terminal and paste this instruction (written for Tailscale). It prepares the HTTPS URL your phone opens.
apps.askPrompt: Make alpacawork usable from my phone. Follow the alpacawork skill’s setup guide (references/setup.md: “Connect”, and the part for this PC’s OS): create the HTTPS entry point on this PC and give its name to alpacawork with setup. The VPN app (Tailscale) is installed and signed in on this PC and on my phone. Tell me when there is something only I can do, such as a command that needs sudo. Do not expose it to the internet.
apps.askReady: The connection is set up. Go on to step 3.
apps.askTitle: Ask an AI on your PC to set up the connection
apps.desktopBody: Open this screen in Chrome or Edge and press <ui>Install</ui> at the right end of the address bar (in Edge, the icon in the same place). alpacawork then opens in its own window from the Dock, the taskbar or the app list.
apps.desktopImage: Chrome’s address bar, with the Install button at its right end marked
apps.desktopInstalled: You are using the installed app now.
apps.desktopOther: If the button is not there: in Safari on a Mac (macOS Sonoma or later), choose <ui>File</ui> → <ui>Add to Dock</ui>. If your browser has no way to install, open this screen in Chrome or Edge.
apps.desktopPromptBody: Once installed, alpacawork opens in its own window from the Dock, the taskbar or the app list.
apps.installAndroidBody: From Chrome’s menu (⋮), choose <ui>Install and create shortcut</ui> → <ui>Install</ui>.
apps.installIosBody: From Safari’s Share menu, choose <ui>Add to Home Screen</ui>.
apps.installIosWebApp: If <ui>Open as Web App</ui> appears, keep it on, then add the app.
apps.installTitle: Open it on your phone and add it to the Home Screen
apps.keepAwake: Keep the PC awake, the server running, and both devices connected to the VPN while you use the app. The screen has no login, so connect only your own devices to the VPN.
apps.manualBody: Create an HTTPS URL on the PC that reaches this app, for example with Tailscale Serve. Then set the host in that URL with this command.
apps.manualHost: For <host>, use the URL without https:// and the trailing slash.
apps.manualLink: How to set up Tailscale Serve
apps.notifyAway: Notifications pause while you are using the app on your PC or phone.
apps.notifyBody: Notifications are turned on for each device. On every PC and phone that should get them, open <ui>{{settings}}</ui> → <ui>{{notifications}}</ui>, press <ui>{{subscribe}}</ui>, and allow notifications.
apps.notifyIos: On an iPhone or iPad, do this in the app opened from the Home Screen icon. It needs iOS / iPadOS 16.4 or later.
apps.notifyOpen: Open notification settings for this device
apps.openInstalled: Open the app from the icon you added to your Home Screen.
apps.openLater: When step 2 is done, a QR code appears here. Scan it with your phone’s camera and open it in the browser recommended below.
apps.openQr: Scan the QR code with your phone’s camera, or enter the URL, and open it in the browser recommended below.
apps.phoneLead: Your phone opens the alpacawork that runs on your PC, over a VPN.
apps.qrLabel: QR code to open this app on your phone
apps.readError: Could not check the configured URL.
apps.vpnBody: Install a VPN app, such as Tailscale, on both devices. Sign in with the same account and connect both.
apps.vpnTitle: Install a VPN app on your PC and phone
apps.vpnWindows: On Windows, install it on Windows itself, not inside Ubuntu (WSL).

card.waitingBody_other: It switches by itself once the {{count}} working agents finish.
